items.name: CFN Engine
items.text: YAML/JSON templates define Parameters, Resources & Outputs. Stacks deploy as a unit, roll back on failure, and reuse nested stacks.

items.name: Safety & Scale
items.text: Change sets preview updates; StackSets span accounts & Regions; drift flags manual edits. DeletionPolicy Retain/Snapshot guards data.

items.name: Data-Platform IaC
items.text: Parameterize templates (Env=dev|prod) via CI/CD for identical envs. Glue, Redshift, MWAA, Kinesis & Lake Formation support CFN.

items: SAM & CDK compile to CloudFormation; never recreate envs manually.
sam package/deploy uploads to S3 — missing artifact bucket or bad CodeUri fails.
No hard-coding: use Parameters, AWS::AccountId/Region & Secrets Manager/SSM.
AWS Cloud9 & CodeCommit are out of scope — never pick them.
